Class SocketServer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.socket.SocketServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class SocketServer extends Object implements Runnable
Socket transport entry point. Listens on a fixed port, accepts client connections and spawns a SocketClientHandler per client, while a SocketDestroyer prunes timed-out connections.
